name: Shebuel
title: Overseer of the Treasures in the Lord's House
summary: Shebuel was a descendant of Moses through his son Gershom. He was appointed as overseer of the treasures in the temple during King David's organization of the Levites' service. His role was important in managing the sanctuary's resources.

keyEvents.title: Lineage from Moses
keyEvents.description: Shebuel is mentioned as the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, and is thus placed in an important Levitical lineage.

keyEvents.title: Overseer of the Treasures
keyEvents.description: Shebuel was appointed as chief overseer of the treasures in the Lord's house during David's organization of the Levites' service.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in David's Organization of the Levites
keyEvents.description: In David's extensive organization of the Levites and their service assignments, Shebuel and his family were given specific areas of responsibility.

keyEvents.title: Descendant of Gershom, Moses' son
keyEvents.description: Shebuel is identified as part of the lineage of Gershom, who was Moses' firstborn son, highlighting the connection between the Mosaic tradition and temple service.

keyEvents.title: Part of the Levitical service arrangement
keyEvents.description: Shebuel and his descendants became part of the permanent service arrangement that David established for the temple which Solomon would later build.
